Context: This store was located in Oakland, California. The owner was a University of California graduate of Japanese descent. On `text(December 8)`, the day after the attack on Pearl Harbor, he placed the “I AM AN AMERICAN” sign on the storefront. After evacuation orders were issued, the store was closed and eventually sold despite the owner’s declaration of loyalty.
